channel.title: GATE Guide — free GATE 2027 guides
channel.description: Free GATE 2027 guides for CSE, ECE, CE, DA, EE and ME: syllabus, weightage, important topics and preparation, by MD ANISH AHAMAD.

item.title: GATE ECE Previous Year Question Papers PDF and Answer Keys
item.description: Official GATE ECE previous year question papers and answer keys, where the archive really lives, the format traps in the older PDFs, and how to use them.

item.title: Networks, Signals and Systems for GATE ECE: Important Topics
item.description: The heaviest section of the GATE EC paper at a counted mean of 17.0 marks. What recurs, what never appears, and what the 2027 syllabus newly names.

item.title: GATE Official Mock Test: Free Link, Release Timing and How to Use It
item.description: The free official GATE mock test for every paper explained. Where the link appears, when it is usually released, how to sit it and what it cannot tell you.

item.title: GATE Network Theory Formula Sheet for ECE and EE, with Traps
item.description: GATE network theory formula sheet for ECE and EE: Thevenin, transients, RLC, phasor power, resonance, two-ports, three-phase and Laplace, each with a trap.

item.title: GATE Mock Test Analysis: How to Review a Mock and Plan the Next Week
item.description: How to analyse a GATE mock test in any branch: an error log, accuracy, attempt rate, marks lost to negatives, and a seven-day fix for each cause.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 Syllabus Changes: What Is New, Gone and Reworded
item.description: GATE ME 2027 syllabus compared phrase by phrase with 2026 from the official PDFs. Thirty phrases added, five removed, nineteen reworded, and what each means.

item.title: GATE General Aptitude Formula Sheet: Every Quant Formula
item.description: GATE General Aptitude formula sheet for every branch, covering percentages, interest, speed, work, numbers, counting, probability, logs, mensuration and clocks.

item.title: GATE Exam Interface Explained: Question Palette, States and Timer
item.description: How the GATE computer-based test screen works in every paper: question palette colours, which states are evaluated, MCQ, MSQ and NAT entry, and the timer.

item.title: GATE Engineering Mathematics Formula Sheet for ECE, EE, ME and CE
item.description: GATE engineering mathematics formula sheet for ECE, EE, ME and Civil: linear algebra, calculus, vector calculus, ODEs, complex variables, probability, numerics.

item.title: Deadlock Questions in GATE CSE: Conditions, Formula, Banker's
item.description: How GATE CSE asks deadlock questions. The four necessary conditions, the minimum-resources formula, safe sequences with the Banker's algorithm.

item.title: GATE CSE Algorithms Formula Sheet: Recurrences, Sorting, Graphs, DP
item.description: GATE CSE algorithms formula sheet: Master theorem, sorting and hashing tables, heap and graph complexities, DP recurrences and counting formulas, each worked.

item.title: How Many Mock Tests for GATE 2027, and When: A Dated Schedule
item.description: How many mock tests to take for GATE 2027 and when to start them, with a week-by-week schedule from October 2026 to the February exam for every branch.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 Subject-Wise Weightage: Six Papers, Counted
item.description: GATE ME subject wise weightage counted from all six Mechanical papers, 2022 to 2026, with each year weighted once and every mean printed beside its range.

item.title: GATE EE Subject-Wise Weightage for 2027, Counted from Five Papers
item.description: GATE EE subject wise weightage counted question by question from the 2022 to 2026 Electrical papers, with the mean, range and share of every section.

item.title: GATE EE Important Topics for 2027, With the Questions Behind Them
item.description: GATE EE important topics for 2027 taken from a count of the 2022 to 2026 Electrical papers, with the question numbers that asked each topic and the gaps.

item.title: GATE DA 2027 Important Topics: The 21 Asked in Every Paper
item.description: GATE DA 2027 important topics from all three DA papers - the 21 topic groups asked every year, the questions behind them, and the named topics never set.

item.title: GATE ME Thermodynamics Formula Sheet 2027: Cycles to Pumps
item.description: GATE ME thermodynamics formula sheet for 2027 with worked examples and traps, from first-law balances and entropy to cycles, combustion and pumps.

item.title: GATE ME Strength of Materials Formula Sheet 2027
item.description: Strength of materials formulas for GATE ME 2027, from elastic constants and Mohr's circle to pressure vessels and columns, each with a worked example.

item.title: GATE ME Heat Transfer Formula Sheet 2027
item.description: Heat transfer formulas for GATE ME 2027, from conduction, fins and the lumped model to convection, LMTD, NTU and radiation, each with a worked example and trap.

item.title: GATE ME Formula Sheet 2027: Key Formulas by Subject
item.description: GATE ME formula sheet for 2027 with key formulas for all ten technical subjects, from Mohr's circle and fins to nozzles and EOQ, and the trap behind each one.
